items.title: Cops bashed Brad, broke his ribs, then charged him with assault
items.description: After fracturing about a dozen of a man's ribs and puncturing his lung, police officers discussed how to explain what happened to him.

items.title: Young Australians reject budget as One Nation popularity climbs further
items.description: Labor's federal budget is falling flat with its target demographic as millennials say they'd rather vote for One Nation than Labor or the Greens, according to a new Redbridge poll.

items.title: Two questions still hang above the now decaying federal budget
items.description: Why has Labor decided to spend the political capital of a 50-seat majority on a minor change to capital gains tax on businesses?

items.title: Australia the 'perfect' target for new Islamist terror network
items.description: Australia would be the "perfect" target for a fledgling Islamist terror network that has carried out antisemitic attacks in Europe, the UK and Canada, experts have warned.

items.title: Liberals grapple with age, gender problems in new party paper
items.description: The Liberal Party has quietly published a paper that floats offering a cut price $10 digital membership to join the party, in an effort to offset its declining numbers.

items.title: Australian housing market stalls in May
items.description: Australia's housing market continues to lose momentum, with national home values flatlining in May as higher interest rates, weak confidence and proposed property tax changes weigh on demand.

items.title: Australia scraps new Virginia-class submarines in AUKUS shake-up
items.description: The US, UK and Australia have announced they will "streamline" the purchase, with Australia no longer buying new submarines, and acquiring three second-hand ones.

items.title: Netanyahu orders deeper incursion into Lebanon as Israeli troops seize castle
items.description: Israeli troops have captured a strategic mountain topped with a Crusader-built castle in southern Lebanon, in their deepest incursion into the country in decades.

items.title: Virgin customers have one month to use COVID travel credits
items.description: The airline had more than $90 million in unspent travel credits on its books earlier this year.

items.title: Dozens killed by blast in rebel-held Myanmar village
items.description: Authorities say the blast was likely caused by explosives used for mining that had been stored in a warehouse.

items.title: Lucky escape for pair as tree falls on car amid WA wild weather
items.description: Two people have had a lucky escape after a tree fell onto their car on a major highway in WA's South West this afternoon, as strong winds lashed the region.

items.title: Panthers hang on as Alamoti makes amends in remarkable Warriors clash
items.description: Penrith wing Paul Alamoti makes up for a horror defensive error with a spectacular winning try as the Panthers down the Warriors 20-18 in an exhilarating top-of-the-table clash.

items.title: West Coast claims fourth win as Essendon's injury nightmare continues
items.description: West Coast makes light work of Essendon at Perth Stadium, as the Bombers lose another promising youngster to a serious injury.

items.title: Ian Thorpe's mythic rise from boy to hero had an ironic twist
items.description: Ian Thorpe become a global star as a teenager, attracting both opportunities and scrutiny. Now, he wishes he'd done some things differently.

items.title: Family lawyers say there has been an uptick in 'prenup' interest
items.description: Binding financial agreements take time and money to obtain. Here's how they work.

items.title: Quiz: Will you be crowned the history champ this week?
items.description: Who took the first five-wicket haul in one-day cricket? And which state capital was the last to get ABC TV?

items.title: Another US air strike in the Pacific kills 'narco-terrorists' taking death toll to 202
items.description: It is the latest strike in a months-long series of attacks from the US on suspected drug trafficking boats in the Caribbean Sea and eastern Pacific Ocean.

items.title: Divers at Laos cave search for two men thought to be trapped further down
items.description: The remaining four men from a group of five were freed from the flooded cave on Saturday evening, in extraordinary and emotional scenes, as search efforts continue for two people thought to still be trapped inside.

items.title: Women abandon football club after sex offender's return
items.description: When a man who sexually assaulted a minor on a post-season football trip was welcomed back to the club with open arms, Megan decided she was done.

items.title: Barnaby Joyce's link to how e-bikes came to be everywhere
items.description: When Barnaby Joyce was deputy prime minister and transport minister in 2021, his assistant minister Kevin Hogan made a quiet, but hugely significant change to the Road Vehicle Standards Act.

items.title: Horses bolt through Rome after police officer sets off fireworks
items.description: Fireworks set off without permission by a police officer during a rehearsal for Italy's Republic Day parade startled dozens of horses, sending them bolting through the capital and injuring several riders.

items.title: The combo that makes tonight's full moon a 'last in a generation' occurrence
items.description: If you look up to the full moon at sunset this evening, you may notice it looks ever so slightly smaller than usual.

items.title: At 15, Mohamed Semra made headlines. At 27, he's making history
items.description: At just 27, Mohamed Semra is not your average mayor. He overcame a childhood stutter and a viral moment in a Melbourne Apple Store to make political history – and he is just getting started.

items.title: Police beat a woman in a Sydney street. Their own camera captured their cruelty
items.description: The family of a woman brutally assaulted by police in Sydney has fought to have body-worn camera vision released, in the hope officers will be better trained in responding to acute mental health situations.

items.title: Love story: Reconnecting with the 'one that got away'
items.description: For a long time, I considered my teenage crush the one that got away. That all changed when we reconnected two decades later.
